name: Treweler Map Builder
author: Aisconverse

sections.description:
Treweler is a flexible WordPress map builder powered by Mapbox. Create responsive, interactive maps for travel guides, property listings, business directories, routes, data visualizations and other location-based projects.

Build maps in the familiar WordPress admin area, choose a ready-made or custom Mapbox style, and publish them as full-screen pages or with shortcodes. No coding is required for everyday setup.

Treweler Free

Treweler Free provides the essential tools for creating polished interactive maps:

  • Create and manage unlimited maps, markers and routes.
  • Use Mapbox Standard, classic or custom Mapbox Studio styles, including 3D terrain, buildings and multiple map projections.
  • Customize markers and responsive popups with flexible styles, content, images, buttons and click actions.
  • Draw routes directly on the map with driving, walking and cycling modes, plus default and hover styles.
  • Configure essential map controls, geolocation, language, attribution and preloaders.
  • Publish maps as full-screen WordPress pages or place them anywhere with shortcodes.
  • Fine-tune presentation with custom CSS classes, additional CSS and JavaScript.

Treweler Pro

Treweler Pro expands the Free version with advanced tools for directories, data-rich maps and larger projects:

  • Organize markers and routes with categories, clustering, templates, custom marker images and text labels.
  • Build rich popups with image galleries and reusable custom fields.
  • Create Store Locator maps with search, filters, geolocation and distance-based sorting.
  • Add interactive tours, information widgets, shapes and detailed country or region boundaries.
  • Import markers from Google Sheets and import or export routes in GPX format.
  • Share specific map states with permalinks and add advanced map, marker and route interactions.
  • Improve large-map performance with optimized markers, dynamic loading and GeoJSON data.

View the complete Treweler Pro feature list, explore Pro demo maps, and browse the available Treweler addons. Addons are available exclusively for Treweler Pro.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.7 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Install from WordPress

  1. Open Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Treweler Map Builder.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open Treweler > Settings > General and add your Mapbox Access Token.
  5. Save the settings and create your first map.

Install from a ZIP file

  1. Open Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  2. Select the Treweler ZIP file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin and add your Mapbox Access Token under Treweler > Settings > General.

Mapbox Access Token

Treweler uses Mapbox to display maps. Create a free Mapbox account, copy a token from your Access Tokens page, and save it under Treweler > Settings > General.
sections.faq:
Is a Mapbox account required?

Yes. Treweler uses the Mapbox platform, so a valid Mapbox Access Token is required to display maps.

Where can I find my Mapbox Access Token?

Sign in to Mapbox and copy a token from your Access Tokens page.

How can I publish a map?

You can display a map as a full-screen WordPress page or place it in your content using a shortcode.
sections.changelog:
1.03.1 – 2026-08-13

  • Fixed – Minor fixes and improvements.
  • Improved – Compatibility with WordPress 7.1.

1.03 – 2026-08-11

  • Updated – Free version based on the current Treweler Pro codebase.
  • Updated – Mapbox GL JS 3.17.0 version support.
  • Added – Treweler style for Fullscreen, Search and Zoom & Pan map controls.
  • Added – Hover styles for Routes.
  • Added – Route border style settings.
  • Added – Popup visibility breakpoint setting.
  • Added – Breakpoint setting to disable marker offset.
  • Added – Addons list page.
  • Added – Additional JavaScript field.
  • Added – Setting for the separate display of standard Compass and Zoom map controls.
  • Added – Map antialiasing setting.
  • Added – Zoom by gesture setting for maps added using shortcode.
  • Added – Fixed popup position.
  • Fixed – Minor fixes and improvements.

1.02 – 2023-10-26

  • Added – New Mapbox Standard map style with 3D environment
  • Added – Day, Dusk, Dawn and Night light presets for the Mapbox Standard style
  • Added – Ability to hide layers for classic and Standard map styles
  • Added – Imperial, metric and nautical units for the distance scale control
  • Fixed – Minor fixes and improvements

1.01 – 2023-08-04

  • Added – Marker offset on click
  • Added – Custom CSS classes for maps
  • Added – Popup close icon
  • Added – Center map on click
  • Added – Marker at the click point on the map
  • Added – Opening a link when clicking on a marker
  • Fixed – Opening links in the same window for maps inserted with a shortcode
  • Changed – Standard Mapbox map styles

1.0 – 2022-10-28

  • Initial release
